scripts.title: Auto Win Auto Walk Auto Rebirth Auto BuyEquip Trail
scripts.features:
· Auto Walk – Moves you in a small circle so you never stop generating steps.
· Auto Win – Saves your current position, locks you at the win spot, and returns you when turned off.
· Auto Bottle Rebirth – Automatically rebirths when your level reaches (rebirths + 1) × 10.
· Auto Buy Trails – Buys every trail with Wins, and stops once all are owned.
· Auto Equip Best Trail – Equips the highest tier trail you own.
